history.text: Phoenicians founded Carthage, which became a Mediterranean power.
Rome destroyed Carthage and made Africa a province.
Kairouan was founded and became an early centre of Islam in the Maghreb.
Independence came on 20 March under Habib Bourguiba.
The uprising that began the Arab Spring ended Ben Ali's rule.

worthSeeing.text: Punic and Roman remains above the Gulf of Tunis, a UNESCO site.

worthSeeing.title: El Jem:
worthSeeing.text: A Roman amphitheatre that held some 35,000 spectators.

worthSeeing.title: Medina of Tunis:
